author: Michael Larabel
description: Valve just published their Steam Survey results for October and point to a small uptick in Linux gaming use on a relative basis...
title: Steam On Linux Just Under 4% For October 2026

author: Michael Larabel
description: Even with Linus Torvalds having been on holiday, Linux 7.4-rc1 is out today on-schedule for capping off the Linux 7.4 merge window...
title: Linux 7.4-rc1 Released With Nice Performance Improvements, AMD Ryzen Zen 6 Preparations & AMDGPU HDMI 2.1 Default

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new KDE terminal emulator is in development as a modern alternative to Konsole. Kwi is this new terminal app being built atop the Ghostty library...
title: Kwi Being Developed As New KDE Terminal Emulator With 3x To 35x Performance

author: Michael Larabel
description: After writing this morning with some stats about the size of the Linux 7.4 merge window and the kernel's source tree approaching 42 million lines, I was curious to run some numbers for putting the size of the merge window into perspective against the major kernel releases of the past 15 years. This shows the definite recent uptick due to AI/LLM activity...
title: The Linux 7.4 Merge Window Is Easily The Largest In Kernel History

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged this weekend for Linux 7.4 and also marked for back-porting to current stable kernel versions are a number of fixes to the OverlayFS union mount file-system...
title: OverlayFS Sees Many Fixes Thanks To AI Code Review

author: Michael Larabel
description: October brought the releases of Linux 7.3, Ubuntu 26.10, the KDE Plasma 6.8 desktop, and a wealth of other open-source software releases. The expanding use of AI/LLMs within Linux kernel development also made for interesting discussions in October. Microsoft bringing their Defender software to the Linux desktop was perhaps the biggest surprise out of October. Here is a look back at the past month...
title: AI Use In The Linux Kernel, Microsoft Defender On Linux & Other October Highlights
